name: establishment-churn
description: Whole sessions lived back to back: establish a link, move one payload, tear down, repeat for the wall-time. Payloads roll from a realistic mix - mostly small command messages on the link itself, NomadNet-page-sized and file-sized resources for the rest - so every cycle pays the full handshake crypto, table tracking, and teardown that sensor check-ins and short-lived interactions pay in the field.
conformance: cycles == receiver's count of delivered payloads; every cycle is a full establish/transfer/teardown
